Job Summary
We blend advanced digital technologies, AI simulation, and deep engineering expertise to transform how products are designed, engineered, manufactured, and maintained. Using digital twins, generative AI, and immersive platforms like NVIDIA Omniverse, we help clients unlock transformative business value.
We operate at the forefront of Physical AI, developing autonomous and intelligent systems through the fusion of simulation, AI, and real-world deployment. We are seeking a Senior Principal Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Omniverse, digital twins, and AI simulation to drive high-impact technical solutioning across global industrial engagements.
Roles & Responsibilities
Architect end-to-end digital twin and AI simulation solutions using NVIDIA Omniverse, OpenUSD, Python extensions, and foundation models.
Define solution blueprints for manufacturing, warehousing, and PLM workflows, integrating generative AI and simulation-driven optimization.
Develop data integration strategies connecting IoT sensors, PLCs, enterprise systems, and AI simulation engines to virtual environments.
Lead client workshops, technical assessments, and roadmap creation for digital twin adoption and maturity.
Extend Omniverse Kit applications, build custom tools, and integrate AI models tailored to client-specific workflows.
Design cloud deployment architectures enabling scalable digital twin and AI simulation solutions.
Apply principles from gaming, real-time simulation, and AI to enhance interactivity, visualization, and predictive analytics.
Support initiatives like synthetic data generation, predictive maintenance, immersive training, and AI-driven optimization.
Professional & Technical Skills
Must Have:
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
7+ years of experience in digital twin and AI simulation architecture, with at least 2 years in Omniverse or similar platforms.
Strong proficiency in Python, OpenUSD, Omniverse Kit SDK, and generative AI frameworks.
Experience with simulation tools (e.g., Siemens, Ansys), IoT platforms, cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP), and AI model integration.
Hands-on familiarity with manufacturing processes, product design workflows, and asset performance management.

Additional Information (Good to Have)
Background in game development or real-time 3D environments (Unity, Unreal).
Experience with NVIDIA RTX rendering, Isaac Sim, robotics simulation, FVDB, or Cosmos World Foundation Models.
Exposure to PLM, MES, ERP systems and integration with digital twin/AI pipelines.
Experience in immersive training, virtual commissioning, or foundation model deployment.
This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
A 15 years full-time education is required.

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network |


Area of Work: Technology M&A |


Level: Senior Manager |


Location: Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune/ Chennai/ Hyderabad/ Kolkata |


Years of Experience: 12-18 years


Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture



  • Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations? Do you thrive in fast-paced transaction environments and enjoy partnering with C-suite executives to drive critical business outcomes?

  • Then this is the right place for you.


The Practice - A Brief Sketch



  • The Technology M&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. We work across the transaction lifecycle, with a strong focus on post-deal signing activities including sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy and exit planning, and execution through Integration Management Offices (IMO) and Separation Management Offices (SMO).

  • Our professionals help clients identify and realize transaction value while managing technology risks, operational dependencies, and transformation opportunities. We work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to design and execute integration and separation strategies that enable successful transaction outcomes.


Key Responsibilities



  • Lead large-scale Technology M&A programs across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, and joint ventures.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior technology executives on transaction-related technology decisions.

  • Lead sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy, and TSA exit execution.

  • Oversee Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, execution, and value realization activities.

  • Define technology integration and separation strategies across applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, ERP, and operating models.

  • Drive synergy identification, value capture, risk mitigation, and transaction execution planning.

  • Lead multi-disciplinary consulting teams and provide overall engagement leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder management.

  • Build executive-level business cases, steering committee materials, and transformation roadmaps.

  • Support business development, proposal creation, thought leadership, and practice growth initiatives.

  • Develop and mentor managers and consultants within the Technology M&A practice.


Bring Your Best Skills Forward



  • Deep experience leading Technology M&A engagements including integrations, separations, carve-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post-merger integration programs.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to manage large, complex, global programs with multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting sales, account growth, and client relationship development.

  • Ability to translate transaction objectives into actionable technology strategies and execution plans.


Technology Domain Experience



  • Candidates should possess practical experience in at least one of the following technology domains and understand how these capabilities evolve during M&A transactions, integrations, and separations:



  1. IT Infrastructure & Cloud



  • Infrastructure integration and separation planning.

  • Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.

  • Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end-user computing environments.

  • Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.



  1. ERP



  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.

  • ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve-out activities.

  • Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.



  1. Enterprise Architecture & IT Operating Model Transformation



  • Enterprise architecture assessments and target-state design.

  • Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.

  • IT operating model design and transformation.

  • Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.

  • Candidates should possess a strong understanding of how technology environments, operating models, applications, and infrastructure are impacted during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs. They should be comfortable advising clients on transaction implications, identifying risks and dependencies, and shaping integration and separation strategies across the deal lifecycle.


What-s in it for You?



  • Opportunity to work on high-profile global M&A transactions and transformative business programs.

  • Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision-making processes.

  • Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.

  • Personalized training and development programs to strengthen transaction, consulting, and leadership capabilities.

  • A diverse and inclusive culture focused on innovation, growth, and continuous learning.


Qualification


Your Experience Counts



  • MBA from a Tier 1 institute preferred.

  • 12-18 years of consulting, deal advisory, technology advisory, transformation, or industry experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading Technology M&A transactions and large-scale integration or separation programs.

  • Strong experience across sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy, and IMO/SMO leadership.

  • Experience leading client engagements, managing senior stakeholders, and overseeing delivery teams.

  • Experience in at least one of the following domains: IT Infrastructure & Cloud, ERP, or Enterprise Architecture & IT Operating Model Transformation.

  • Proven ability to originate opportunities, contribute to sales pursuits, and support practice growth.

  • Strong understanding of modern enterprise technologies including cloud, cybersecurity, AI, data, and digital platforms.
